note: v2.2 plan 04 Phase A. One memory pool per world; each window lists the notes its next reply needs. Importance/createdAt/entities are varied so the static score is not trivially right. Labels written before any judge answer was read.

sun-ruins.text: Arin distrusts Max since he lied about the map.
Ponticius raised the Sun Ruins reward to 500 crowns.
Luke is twelve and has never left town.
The sphinx's riddle is about the moon's reflection in still water.
Arin is allergic to desert lilies.
The front gate of the ruins collapsed; the side tunnel is the only way in.
Max owes the tavern keeper 12 crowns.
Bitterroot from the side tunnels stops bleeding when chewed and packed into a cut.
Arin was cut badly on the arm when the gate collapsed.
Luke promised their mother he would be home before the harvest festival.
The guild's job board is emptied every seventh day.
The Sun's Heart burns anyone who touches it with bare skin.
Arin learned swordplay from a pirate captain in her youth.
Max carries a pair of thick leather gloves from his smithing days.
Ponticius once cheated a caravan out of its pay.
Luke is terrified of the dark.
The party has two torches left.
Sandstorms rise in the afternoon and die by dusk.
Arin wants her share of the reward to buy back her family's ship.
The sphinx lets a party try its riddle only once.

ship.text: The long-range antenna was torn off by debris; only short-range calls work.
Kepler Station answers short-range hails only.
Pell hates being interrupted mid-repair.
Captain Okafor lost her previous ship to a reactor fire.
Coolant loop two is bypassed and cannot take another overload.
There are four escape pods on deck two.
HALO refuses orders that would vent crew sections.
Pell keeps a bottle of contraband whisky in the engine room.
The hull breach on deck three was sealed with four patches.
Max is the ship's pilot.
The asteroid field near Kepler blinds long-range sensors.
Okafor promised the crew a bonus if they reach Kepler intact.
The galley replicator only makes oatmeal now.
Pell and Okafor argued about whether to abandon ship.
The ship's name is the Long Dark.
Short-range thrusters on the port side are sluggish after the strike.
HALO logs every command in a black box on the bridge.
Oxygen reserves are at sixty percent.
Pell's sister works at Kepler Station's repair dock.
Okafor distrusts station authorities.

manor.text: Graves works the portrait mechanism from behind the gallery wall.
Lady Ashworth is selling the house to pay her late husband's debts.
The carriage leaves from the east gate at sunset.
Graves has served the family for forty years.
Max found the family records in the library.
The records show Graves is Lady Ashworth's half-brother.
The library holds three hundred volumes on botany.
Lady Ashworth wears black mourning clothes.
Graves polishes the silver every morning.
The east wing roof leaks in the rain.
Lady Ashworth has not spoken to Graves since the reveal.
The grandfather's portrait hides the lever.
Max is a hired appraiser for the buyer.
The garden hedges were planted by the first Lord Ashworth.
Graves keeps the key to the wine cellar.
Lady Ashworth's husband died in the portrait gallery.

openArcs: Can Arin keep fighting with her wound?

transcript.speaker: Arin
transcript.text: "It's still bleeding. I can barely hold the sword."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Hold on. Let me look for something in these tunnels to stop it."

transcript.speaker: DM Narrator
transcript.text: The Sun's Heart glows on the altar, pulsing with heat.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Careful. Nobody grab it yet. Let me think how to carry it."

openArcs: Can the crew call for help without the antenna?

transcript.speaker: Captain Okafor
transcript.text: "Max, raise Kepler. Tell them we're coming in hot."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "HALO, open a channel to Kepler Station."

transcript.speaker: Pell
transcript.text: "If you push the engines any harder, I can't promise anything."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Pell, can the reactor handle full burn for ten minutes?"

transcript.speaker: HALO
transcript.text: "Docking approach aligned. Port thrusters responding at seventy percent."

transcript.speaker: Lady Ashworth
transcript.text: "Why would a servant go to such lengths to keep strangers out of my house?"

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Because it's not only your house, my lady. Read this page of the records."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Then I had better not miss my ride back to town."
